newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: WTO panel to discuss EU banana appeal late July.
newsitem.headline: WTO panel to discuss EU banana appeal late July.

text.p: A World Trade Organisation appeals board is to hear both sides in the European Union-U.S. dispute over EU banana import regulations later this month, trade diplomats said on Friday.

The session, on July 21 and 22, will follow a submission by the EU on Thursday of a detailed case seeking revision of a WTO dispute panel finding in May that the regulations violated the body's rules and should be changed.
The EU arguments had originally been due to be presented on Friday, but the presentation was moved forward one day, trade diplomats said.

There were no immediate details of the arguments put forward by the EU, which is strongly supported in the case by banana-producing states in the Caribbean, who argue their economies could be devastated if the original finding is allowed to stand.
The U.S. complaint, based on objections from big banana-marketing corporations in the U.S., is backed by Latin American producers including Ecuador and Mexico.
The three members of the appeals panel should report their findings by mid-September under WTO dispute procedure, but diplomats say the complicated nature of the case could lead to a delay.
